title: Planet discovery Aquilo
description: A freezing wasteland with bottomless oceans of liquid ammonia that cannot be landfilled. Precarious icebergs are the closest thing to solid ground and can be extended with floating ice platform. Structures and belts will freeze if not heated by adjacent heat pipe or other hot structures, but must be placed on concrete to not melt the ice below.

effects.description: Unlock recipe: Solid fuel from ammonia

title: Planet discovery Fulgora
description:
A dry wind-swept planet with lightning storms on plateaus, and oceans of oil that can be bridged by elevated rails.
There appear to be some ruins.

title: Planet discovery Gleba
description:
A humid swampy planet with nutrient-rich bogs. Wetland can support agriculture but is difficult to build on, it can be landfilled but stone is scarce.
Snaking hills have stone and are better to build on but can't support agriculture.

title: Planet discovery Vulcanus
description: A hot volcanic planet with mountainous volcanoes, rivers of lava, plains of ash, and sulfuric acid geysers. Rich in metals. Lava can only be crossed by elevated rail.
